channel.title: REGOL news
channel.description: Every REGOL release, what it changes, and why it was worth doing.

item.title: REGOL 1.9: six questions in your browser, and a week lands on your phone
item.description: Answer six questions on the website and the whole rotation comes back as a code your camera reads, offline. A finished workout travels the same way. Also: a first run that opens on three ways in, Stats that leads with its three numbers, You as a hub of seven pages, a workout notice that says the engine's reason, and three ways to pay.

item.title: REGOL 1.8: a lift can now ask for a different set each time
item.description: Every set of a lift can now ask for its own rep range and reps in reserve, and REGOL judges each one against what it asked for. Also: Why these weights on Today, full-size lift charts, rebuilt share cards, and Plans split into two tabs.
